Property.name: MAX_NUMBER_OF_TRAITS_FOR_IMP
Property.Description_ENG: Number if Skill Traits available when creating IMP.

Property.name: MODIFIER_FOR_APS_ADDED_ON_AIMED_HTH_ATTACKS
Property.Description_ENG: ****************************************************************************************************************************** this controls how many APs the aimed punches or knife-stabs cost The modifier presents a number multiplied by basic aim-click AP cost (usually 4) added to the original punch/stab APs. So "3" set here means +12 APs on top of basic punch/stab APs. ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Property.name: DAMAGE_NEEDED_TO_LOSE_STATS
Property.Description_ENG: ****************************************************************************************************************************** This is the minimum damage a soldier can receive for stat loss to occur. The chance to loose any stat is also measured by this. Normally this was 30, we set it to half by default in STOMP, because we can repair stats now with doctor trait ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Property.name: FOCUS_SKILL_RADIUS
Property.Description_ENG: The 'Focus' skill allows a merc to pay special attention to an area in their view While focus is active, they have an improved interrupt chance against all targets in that area, but drastically lowered interrupt chance against all targets outside. Only works if center of area is in view and a gun is aimed. Focus can be activated by calling the skill menu in tactical with '$' and then selecting 'Various' and then 'Focus'. The radius of the area depends on how close the merc is, the area increases with distance. Base radius of focus area for range 20.

Property.Description_ENG: AI artillery: the total sum of mortars points is determined by the quality of soldiers

Property.name: RADIO_OPERATOR_MORTAR_RADIUS
Property.Description_ENG: artillery shells land within a x tiles radius of their target

Property.name: RADIO_OPERATOR_MORTAR_SIGNAL_SHELL_RADIUS
Property.Description_ENG: the initial signal shell lands within x tiles radius of their target

Property.name: RADIO_OPERATOR_REINFORCEMENT_SETTING
Property.Description_ENG: controls whether player-ctonrtolled operators can call militia reinforcements from adjacent sectors This also requires AllowReinforcements to be 1 in DifficultySettings.xml 0: not at all 1: if they are in the same town 2: if either this or the adjacent sector is in a town 3: possible in all sectors

Property.name: RADIO_OPERATOR_ASSIGNMENT_SCAN_BASE_RANGE
Property.Description_ENG: scan assignment: detect enemies up to x sectors away

Property.name: RADIO_OPERATOR_LISTENING_HEARING_BONUS
Property.Description_ENG: we can use our radio set to listen, this will greatly enhance our hearing, but makes it easier to interrupt us

Property.name: RADIO_OPERATOR_JAMMING_BLOCKSRADIOBOMBS
Property.Description_ENG: if frequencies are jammed, bombs cannot be activated/defused by remote

Property.name: RADIO_OPERATOR_ENEMY_JAMMINGSETSOFFRADIOBOMBS
Property.Description_ENG: if a enemy radio operators jams frequencies, there is a 5% chance that he will activate remote bombs/defuses

Property.name: BASE_CHANCE
Property.Description_ENG: Base chance that snitch will inform about certain event (in percents)

Property.name: MERC_OPINION_ABOUT_SNITCH_BONUS_MODIFIER
Property.Description_ENG: How much chance is increased by relation between snitch and target (0.0 - 10.0) Note: by default relations are rated from -25 (hated) to 25 (buddy)

Property.name: SNITCH_OPINION_ABOUT_MERC_BONUS_MODIFIER
Property.Description_ENG: How much chance is decreased by relation between snitch and target (0.0 - 10.0) Note: by default relations are rated from -25 (hated) to 25 (buddy)

Property.name: SNITCH_LEADERSHIP_BONUS_MODIFIER
Property.Description_ENG: How much chance is increased, depending on snitch's leadership skill (0.0 - 10.0)

Property.name: SOCIABLE_MERC_BONUS
Property.Description_ENG: Bonus to chance if merc is sociable (-100 - 100)

Property.name: LONER_MERC_BONUS
Property.Description_ENG: Bonus to chance if merc is loner (-100 - 100)

Property.name: SAME_ASSIGNMENT_BONUS
Property.Description_ENG: Bonus to chance if snitch and merc are on the same assignment (-100 - 100)

Property.name: MERC_OPINION_ABOUT_MERC_TRESHOLD
Property.Description_ENG: For reports "merc hates merc" final chance is proportional to dislike in range between treshold (0%) and -25(100%) (-25 - 25)

Property.name: PASSIVE_REPUTATION_GAIN
Property.Description_ENG: Reputation gain per day if snitch is happy (0 - 100)

Property.name: HEARING_RANGE_BONUS
Property.Description_ENG: Hearing range bonus (0 - 100)

Property.name: PRISON_SNITCH_INTERROGATION_MULTIPLIER
Property.Description_ENG: Undercover snitch interrogation effectivness multiplier (compared to normal interrogation) (0.0 - 10.0)

Property.name: PRISON_SNITCH_GUARD_STRENGTH_MULTIPLIER
Property.Description_ENG: Undercover snitch guarding effectivness multiplier (compared to normal guards) (0.0 - 10.0)

Property.name: GROUP_TIME_SPENT_FOR_TRAVELLING_BY_FOOT_REDUCTION
Property.Description_ENG: Strategic map travel speed increased by a percentage if a survivalist is present in group

Property.name: MAX_STACKABLE_LESS_TRAVEL_TIME_BONUSES
Property.Description_ENG: Maximum of above travel time bonuses that can be stacked for one group (1 Survival = 1 bonus, 2 Survival = 2 bonuses etc.)

Property.name: ENERGY_SPENT_TRAVEL_REDUCTION
Property.Description_ENG: Percentage reduction of stamina burn when travelling (This only applies for survivalist himself.)

Property.name: WEATHER_PENALTIES_REDUCTION
Property.Description_ENG: Percentage of weather penalties reduced. Values from 0.0 to 1.0.

Property.name: CAMO_WORNOUT_SPEED_REDUCTION
Property.Description_ENG: Camouflage wear out percentage speed reduction

Property.name: TRACKER_MAX_RANGE
Property.Description_ENG: Survivalists can look out for tracks of people. This can be activated in the [Ctrl] + [C] menu. This is the maximum range at which one can spot tracks.

Property.name: TRACKER_ABILITY
Property.Description_ENG: per level of the trait, we can spot tracks at up to TRACKER_ABILITY % of TRACKER_MAX_RANGE. Values from 0 to 50, default 30.

Property.name: DISEASE_RESISTANCE
Property.Description_ENG: reduce likelihood of getting diseases by x percent values from 0% to 100%

Property.name: FOOD_CONSUMPTION
Property.Description_ENG: modifies how fast food is consumed, e.g. -50 means food consumption is lowered by 50% values from -100% to 100%

Property.name: SNAKE_EVADE_BONUS
Property.Description_ENG: bonus to evade snake attacks in water

Property.name: CAMO_EFFECTIVENESS_BONUS
Property.Description_ENG: bonus to base camouflage effectiveness
